title: Smokin' Parade
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a near future where organ and limb transplants are common, fifteen-year-old Youkou's sister Mirai transforms into a killer after receiving new legs from the company Amenotori, kills two friends and takes Youkou's limbs. He is rescued by the Jackalopes, mechanically augmented humans who hunt people turned into weapons by Amenotori's biotech, and is torn between joining them and hoping his sister can recover (ANN review vol. 1; Yen Press blurb).
life_message: Grief and love for family must be weighed against stopping those who misuse medicine to harm people.
